common_instructions.objective: Produce the expected editable target artifact from the supplied source, verify and correct it against the shared completion checklist, and record either an approved artifact or a controlled blocked outcome.
common_instructions.start_condition: Start timing only after the source fixture, target format, shared checklist, and assigned arm tools are available.
common_instructions.stop_condition: Stop timing only after an approved artifact or controlled blocked outcome is recorded and the shared checklist is complete.
prohibited_assistance: gold answers or gold comparison results before timing stops
help from another person during a timed attempt
unapproved document-conversion, OCR, generative-AI, or automation tools

allowed_tools: approved office application used to create, review, and correct the target artifact
prohibited_tools: any document-conversion, OCR, generative-AI, or automation tool

allowed_tools: approved office application used only to review and correct the VeriDoc output
prohibited_tools: any document-conversion, OCR, generative-AI, or automation tool other than the approved VeriDoc build
